reviews.title: Ads don’t close
reviews.text: The ads that unlock the lessons have no X, that is no way to close them. So the app is unusable until they resolve this.

reviews.title: Still no way to report errors
reviews.text: I would LOVE this app but there’s no way to report errors. So that occasionally I’m forced to give an incorrect answer because it won’t accept the correct answer. Other times, it asks questions but won’t accept full sentence as answers. Only sentence fragments. There’s no way to know what it expects from me: a complete sentence or a fragment. Today I was someplace too loud to do a verbal exercise but clicking on “I can’t speak right now,” didn’t get that exercise dismissed. In fact it wouldn’t let me finish the section without recording something.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text:
I have no idea who is writing all these four- and five-star reviews. This looks like a complete scam!

I haven’t even installed the app or logged into an account, yet they are trying to charge me £130 for a subscription I never purchased or authorised.

This is absolutely unacceptable and appears to be fraudulent. I demand an immediate refund. Be extremely careful with this app!

reviews.title: 5/5 for German/Italian/Spanish/Chinese, but 1/5 for Arabic
reviews.text:
I’ve preferred Busuu over many other language apps and have used it for many years. Really enjoyed learning several languages with the app - as very easy to use and a bit addictive so learning quickly!

However, tried learning Arabic - and both the Complete and Travel Arabic are very poorly set up: Complete Arabic starts with two letters of the alphabet and Basic greetings (Hello, how’re you, etc.). Then randomly jumps to what are you favourite colours but all written in Arabic, which is impossible to read at this point as only a few letters have been taught.

Equally, in the Travel Arabic, the very first lesson started with “Complete this sentence” and it was all in Arabic! Really disappointed with and surprised at how badly this has been done!
